cases.title: Double-click on the DP1 downpipe circle opens the CE Edit source window
cases.expected: A double-click on the outer circle of a freshly placed downpipe (tag DP1) opens CE's 'Edit source' window with DP1 in its Tag box, and not AutoCAD's Enhanced Attribute Editor. Cancel closes it.
cases.why_not_unit: Unit tests passed while the real AutoCAD double-click still reached EATTEDIT with nothing picked (BUG-859 round 1); only a real mouse double-click on a real block shows which window opens.
not_automated: The name of the Tag box in the Edit source window is not proven (the window has never opened); the check 'control Tag value DP1' uses the name 'Tag' and may need that one word corrected once the fix is installed.
The red centre, the angled DP text and the green label (BUG-860) are not clicked here; only the outer circle named in the bug.

cases.title: A finished CE command writes one outcome line to the CE log
cases.expected: CDCHECKCURRENT (the drawing check) runs without a window or a question, and the Civil CE log gains exactly one line 'Command outcome: CDCHECKCURRENT completed <n> ms' while it runs.
cases.why_not_unit: The line is written by the installed plugin when a real AutoCAD command ends; only a live run shows it reaches the log file that the log watcher reads.
not_automated: The 'cancelled' word is recorded by case R09 (the DP command ended by Esc) and the 'refused' case is recorded by R10 (CDCHECKIGNORE with its switch off); neither word is judged, because BUG-862 says today's words are wrong for both.

cases.title: The Settings window opens, Cancel closes it, and Tim's four settings files are unchanged
cases.plan_item: Settings window (spec C13 and C14, reduced to open and Cancel)
cases.expected: CDS opens 'Creative Engineering | Settings (CDS)' with the tabs Drafting, Pipes and Pits, Design, Survey, Display, Advanced, Newer tools and Fixes, a Cancel and a Save button, and the line 'No changes. Everything shown is saved.'; Cancel closes it; the four settings files have the same SHA-256 as before the window was opened (checked BEFORE the guard's restore runs).
cases.why_not_unit: The window loads Tim's real settings file in real AutoCAD; only a live run shows that opening it and pressing Cancel writes nothing.
not_automated: Changing a value and pressing Cancel (spec C14) and the per-tab look (C13): this case proves open, read, Cancel and unchanged files only.
